description_full:
**Company Description**

Laku6 is the leading AI-first end-to-end electronics recommerce platform in Indonesia where our technology has helped over 500,000 users sell their gadgets directly for cash or via Trade-In with leading eCommerce Partners. Laku6 is part of Carousell Group, the leading multi-category platform for secondhand in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to make secondhand the first choice. Founded in August 2012 in Singapore, the Group has a leading presence in seven markets under the brands Carousell, Carousell Media Group, Cho Tot, Laku6, LuxLexicon, Mudah.my, OneShift, REFASH and Revo Financial, serving tens of millions of monthly active users. Carousell is backed by leading investors including Telenor Group, Rakuten Ventures, Naver, STIC Investments, 500 Global and Peak XV Partners (formerly known as Sequoia Capital India).

Laku6 is the leading AI-first end-to-end Electronics Recommerce platform in Indonesia where our technology has helped over 500,000 users sell their gadgets directly for cash or via Trade-In with leading eCommerce Partners and in over 1,000 offline retail shops. We believe that making it easier for sellers to sell and safer for buyers to buy used-electronics and smartphones is a critical step to achieving that.

Visit www.laku6.com for more information.

**Job Description**

We're currently looking for a **Creative Design Intern** with a strong eye for visuals and storytelling to join our team in Indonesia to support strategic Marketing initiatives.

If you love crafting engaging digital assets and editing videos that leave an impact, we’d love to have you on our team. You’ll work closely with our marketing and design teams to bring ideas to life across social media, web, and other digital platforms.

**Internship Period : 6 Months (preferred)**

**Responsibilities**

* Create static and motion graphics for digital platforms (social media, email, website, etc.)
* Edit short-form videos for promotional campaigns, product explainers, reels, or behind-the-scenes content
* Assist in maintaining brand consistency across all design outputs
* Support in concept development and brainstorming sessions
* Adapt designs based on feedback and multiple formats
* Manage file organization and prepare assets for publishing

**Qualifications**

**To succeed in your learning journey with us, you need to have.**

* Proficiency in graphic design tools (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva)
* Video editing skills using tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or similar
* Understanding of social media trends and content formats
* A good sense of typography, layout, and color
* Portfolio of past design and video editing work (even student/personal projects)
* Ability to take feedback and iterate quickly
* Bonus: Experience in animation (After Effects or similar)
* Be available for a 6-month internship
* Able to use personal laptop during internship
* Able to work in Indonesia.

**Additional Information**

**What You'll Gain**

* Hands-on experience in a fast-paced, creative environment
* Mentorship from experienced designers and marketers
* A chance to build your portfolio with real brand work
* Potential pathway to a full-time opportunity

By proceeding with your application**,** you are adhering to our PDPA policies. In case you are interested to know more, read about our Candidates Personal Data Privacy Statement.
